stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code now in force

stations.instrument: Responsum ad propositum dubium, coetus ordinarius 4 Iunii 1999 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Negative, and with a stated mind: any action voluntarily and gravely despising the sacred species is included in the word. This is the one entry the collection's President commented on, in Italian and in English, and the only place in the whole collection where c. 16 §2 is cited at all -- and even there for the fact of confirmation and promulgation, not to name a species.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
